hook.text: Introducing Loom AI / Record better, faster video messages
hook.technique_other: product-announcement title reveal: kinetic word-by-word headline with an AI sparkle morph, no question or stat

summary.tone: Upbeat, polished and calm-confident: a music-driven, voice-over-free feature reel in Loom's dark-purple brand world with soft glossy spheres, gentle glows and quick kinetic type.

signature_moments.description: A webcam bubble's stop-record click morphs into the full recreated Loom player card, whose title pill types itself.
signature_moments.why_premium: One continuous morph links the product's core action (record) to the AI result (auto title) with no cut, which reads as bespoke motion design rather than a screen capture.

signature_moments.description: One persistent player card is reframed by continuous camera moves to reveal summaries, chapters, tasks and filler-word removal in turn.
signature_moments.why_premium: A single hero object carried through every feature gives spatial continuity and makes five features feel like one product story; there are no hard cuts, only choreographed reframes.

signature_moments.description: The AI sparkle from the intro returns and morphs through a rounded diamond into the Loom logo mark.
signature_moments.why_premium: Bookending the opening sparkle with the logo resolve closes the visual loop and ties the AI feature to the brand mark.

hook.evidence: Attractive kinetic intro with sparkle morph and drifting spheres, but the hook is a plain announcement ('Introducing Loom AI') with no problem, stat or question; competent rather than gripping.

clarity.evidence: Each feature gets one short headline plus a simplified UI demo (summary box, chapter bar, task pill, removed 'uhm' pills), one idea per beat. Some beats are brief (s003 ~2.2 s) and the filler-removal panel uses placeholder bars, so details pass quickly.

ui_showcase.evidence: UI is recreated and simplified (placeholder bars instead of real text) around a single player card, with cursor clicks and state changes; very clean and legible, though it abstracts away from the real product UI.

motion_polish.evidence: Continuous reframes instead of cuts, morphs (bubble to card, sparkle to logo), typewriter and word-by-word reveals, staggered lists, depth-layered blurred spheres and a slow fade to the logo hold; consistent and refined throughout.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from anchors plus visuals: 68 SFX candidates in 0-31.2 s, mostly chime-classified, roughly one every ~0.46 s at a 152 BPM beat grid, so accents track the on-beat word reveals and clicks; master is loud at -10.39 LUFS integrated. No SFX candidates are detected after 31.2 s (s008-s009), where music alone carries the tagline and logo. I cannot hear the mix, so sweetening quality beyond these counts is unverified.

vo_script_quality.evidence: No voice-over: anchors contain no transcript words; the story is told with on-screen text only.

brand_consistency.evidence: One dark-purple world with iridescent spheres, gradient strokes and a single sans family from intro to logo; the recurring AI sparkle opens and closes the piece and resolves into the Loom mark.

works_muted.evidence: There is no voice-over; every feature is named by an on-screen headline and shown visually, so the full story reads with sound off.

overall.evidence: A highly polished, cohesive 47 s feature reel with excellent continuous motion and branding; held back by a generic announcement hook and no explicit call to action beyond the logo end card.

localization_friendliness.notes: No voice-over, so only text needs translating, but all headlines, the typed summary, chapter labels, task pill and tagline are baked into the animation and timed to word-by-word/typewriter reveals, so each language needs a re-render and retiming. Abstract placeholder bars in the transcript panel help; the greeting bubbles are already multilingual.

annotation.shot_type_other: multi-phase sequence: abstract sparkle intro + kinetic type, then circular presenter bubble with record button, then recreated Loom player card
annotation.focal_element: Centered headline text, then circular presenter-camera bubble, then floating video-player card
annotation.typography: Clean geometric sans, medium/semibold weight, sentence case, normal-to-slightly-tight tracking; words reveal one by one with dim-to-bright fade. Title pill uses a smaller semibold sans inside a gradient-outlined rounded pill. Font guess (low confidence): a grotesk such as Circular-like.
annotation.what_happens: A small orb morphs into a four-point AI sparkle on a dark purple field while glossy gradient spheres drift in at different depths. 'Introducing Loom AI' types in word by word with the sparkle trailing, clears, then 'Record better, faster video messages' reveals word by word and fades out. A circular presenter webcam bubble pops in, a red stop-record button appears and a hand cursor clicks it; the bubble then resolves into a recreated Loom video-player card (Market Trends slide with presenter bubble) with a soft glow, and a gradient-outlined pill above it types 'With titles that write themselves' ending in a sparkle.
annotation.build_rebuild: On a dark purple full-bleed background with blurred gradient spheres drifting at varied speeds, morph a dot into a 4-point star, reveal centered headlines word by word (opacity 0.4->1 per word on beat), then scale-in a circular avatar with a red stop button clicked by a cursor, and cross-morph it into a glowing rounded player card while a gradient-stroked pill above types its title character by character.

annotation.focal_element: AI summary text box below the cropped player card
annotation.transition_other: continuous upward camera pan/reframe: player card slides up and out of the top while new content appears below (no visible cut)
on_screen_text: Shorten the distance from Record to Share with AI-powered summaries. Loom AI will generate a summary of your video right after you record, making it easy to get your message across.
annotation.typography: Heading in bold geometric sans, sentence case, left-aligned; body in small regular sans inside a rounded box whose gradient stroke draws on; body text types out character by character.
annotation.what_happens: The frame pans up so the player card sits cropped at the top. 'And AI-powered summaries' types in left-aligned below it, a rounded box's gradient outline draws on, and the summary paragraph types out inside it typewriter-style; by the end the heading and box dim as the next move begins.
annotation.build_rebuild: Translate the player card up ~60% of frame height, then type a bold left-aligned heading, draw a rounded rectangle's gradient stroke around its perimeter, and typewriter-reveal a two-line body paragraph inside it, finishing with a 0.3s opacity dim before the next reframe.

annotation.focal_element: Player card's chapter progress bar segments with labels
annotation.transition_other: continuous downward reframe: summary content leaves, card returns to center with new headline above (likely slide/pan; not a hard cut visually)
on_screen_text: AI chapters add clarity to your videos
annotation.typography: Headline in bold geometric sans, sentence case, centered, slightly open tracking; chapter labels in small medium-weight white sans above the segmented progress bar.
annotation.what_happens: The player card is centered under the headline 'AI chapters add clarity to your videos'. The progress bar at the card's bottom is split into chapter segments; the first segment is filled and labelled 'Introducing', and the second fills as 'Automatic' appears. Background spheres drift slowly.
annotation.build_rebuild: Center the glowing player card under a bold headline, divide its progress bar into 5 segments with gaps, and animate the playhead fill across segment 2 while its chapter label fades in above it.

annotation.focal_element: Timestamped chapter list below the player card
annotation.transition_other: continuous upward reframe: card slides up and a chapter list appears beneath (no visible cut)
annotation.typography: Chapter timestamps in a monospaced face, tinted, regular weight; chapter titles in regular sans, title case; progress-bar labels in small medium sans.
annotation.what_happens: The card moves up and a four-row chapter list (timestamp + title) staggers in below it. A hand cursor moves to the last row '04:18 Chapters' and clicks; the timestamp highlights and the progress bar fills to the 'Chapters' segment while the list dims.
annotation.build_rebuild: Slide the card up, stagger-fade four list rows (mono timestamp + sans title) at ~0.15s offsets, move a hand cursor to row 4, highlight its timestamp on click and jump the progress-bar fill to the last segment as the list fades to 40% opacity.

annotation.focal_element: Suggested Tasks side panel with 'For Addie' task pill, then the headline about trimming filler words
annotation.transition_other: continuous reframe: card slides down to center while a Suggested Tasks panel enters from the right (no visible cut)
on_screen_text: AI-assigned tasks keep your team in sync
Choose one concept for the intro
Automatically trim out filler words and long silent pauses
annotation.typography: Headlines in bold geometric sans, sentence case, centered, slightly open tracking; second headline wraps to two centered lines. Panel label 'Suggested Tasks' in small semibold tinted sans; task pill title in medium sans with tiny regular subtext.
annotation.what_happens: The card recenters with 'AI-assigned tasks keep your team in sync' above and a Suggested Tasks panel to its right listing tasks with check icons; the first task, a highlighted 'For Addie' pill, is clicked by a hand cursor and its check turns green. The headline and panel clear, then 'Automatically trim out filler words and long silent pauses' reveals word by word above the card while the progress bar shows all segments.
annotation.build_rebuild: Recenter the player card, slide in a right-side task list whose first item is a filled rounded pill, animate a cursor click that swaps its check icon to a green filled state, then fade out the panel and headline and reveal a new two-line centered headline word by word.

annotation.focal_element: Transcript panel on the right with highlighted 'uhm' and 'Ns silence' pills being removed
annotation.transition_other: continuous reframe: player card slides left and is cropped by the frame edge while a Transcript panel appears on the right (no visible cut)
annotation.typography: Tab labels in small medium-weight sans, title case, active tab 'Transcript' brighter than the dimmed others; filler/silence pills in small semibold lowercase sans inside rounded pills with a gradient (pink-to-violet) outline; transcript lines are abstract rounded bars, not real text.
annotation.what_happens: The player card shifts left (cropped mid-word 'Market Trends') and a dark transcript panel with Edit/Comments/Transcript/Views tabs sits to its right. Transcript lines are placeholder bars studded with outlined 'uhm', '3s silence' and '9s silence' pills; a soft blurred circle sweeps across and the pills disappear one by one, the lines closing up until the panel shows only clean bars.
annotation.build_rebuild: Split the frame with the cropped player card on the left and a tabbed panel of rounded placeholder bars on the right, insert gradient-outlined pills labelled 'uhm' and 'Ns silence' inline, then sweep a blurred circular 'eraser' across the panel and scale each pill to 0 in sequence while neighbouring bars tween to close the gap.

annotation.composition_other: mostly empty dark frame with the player card and panel cropped along the top edge mid-move
annotation.focal_element: Player card bottom edge and progress bar exiting through the top of frame
annotation.transition_other: continuous upward camera pan: the card and transcript panel scroll up and out, leaving empty background (no visible cut)
annotation.what_happens: A 0.6 s bridge: the camera pans down the scene (content moves up) so the player card and transcript panel slide off the top, leaving the dark purple background empty before the next scene.
annotation.build_rebuild: Tween the whole UI group's y position upward by ~100% of frame height over ~0.6 s with a strong ease-in-out so the frame empties out before the next scene enters from below.

annotation.focal_element: Centered headline 'All available in 50+ languages' surrounded by greeting bubbles
annotation.transition_other: continuation of the upward pan: a field of glossy greeting bubbles scrolls in with the headline already centered (likely; transition not fully visible at 2 fps)
annotation.typography: Headline in medium-weight geometric sans, sentence case, centered on two lines, normal tracking; the number swaps from '31' to '50+' in place. Greetings in semibold sans set inside glossy spheres, size scaling with sphere size; several are cropped by the frame edge.
annotation.what_happens: A centered headline reads 'All available in 31 languages' and the number quickly ticks to '50+'. Iridescent pink-violet spheres labelled with greetings in many languages (Ciao!, Hello!, Привет!, Hej!, Hallo!, Bonjou...) drift upward at different speeds and sizes, the far ones defocused; at the end the headline dims to low opacity.
annotation.build_rebuild: Center a two-line headline whose number tweens/steps from 31 to '50+', surround it with gradient-shaded circles of varied radius each carrying a greeting label, drift them upward at speeds proportional to size with blur on the smallest/farthest layer, and fade the headline to ~40% opacity at the end.

annotation.shot_type_other: kinetic tagline followed by logo resolve end card
annotation.focal_element: Centered tagline, then the Loom logo lockup
annotation.transition_other: continuous drift: greeting bubbles float up and out and the previous headline is gone, leaving plain spheres (no visible cut)
on_screen_text: With Loom AI, make your first take your best take
annotation.typography: Tagline in medium-weight geometric sans, sentence case, centered over three lines, revealed line by line; wordmark 'loom' in a bold rounded lowercase sans beside a starburst icon. Font guess (low confidence): Circular-like grotesk.
annotation.what_happens: The greeting bubbles drift away leaving unlabeled glossy spheres. 'With Loom AI,' appears, then 'make your first take' and 'your best take' reveal line by line; the tagline dims and clears. A four-point AI sparkle appears center, morphs into a rounded diamond, then resolves into the Loom starburst + 'loom' wordmark, whose text brightens. The spheres slowly drift, defocus and fade until only the logo remains on the flat purple background for the final seconds.
annotation.build_rebuild: Reveal a three-line centered tagline line by line on beat, fade it out, then morph a 4-point star path into a rounded diamond and into the starburst logo mark while the wordmark fades from dim to white, and slowly blur-and-fade the background spheres to leave a ~2.5 s static logo hold.

pattern.description: A lone AI sparkle in the centre bursts outward into floating gradient spheres while the camera pushes in; the title 'Introducing Loom AI' then fades up word by word, with the sparkle settling as a superscript accent after 'AI'.
pattern.why_premium: The sparkle is a single hero object that both seeds the spheres (motion origin) and ends as the brand accent, so the opening reads as one continuous gesture; word-by-word reveal is timed to the music hits, and depth comes from sphere blur and parallax rather than flat slides.

pattern.description: The headline fades out while a floating gradient orb rises to centre and swells; the orb's fill dissolves into a circular presenter video (mask reveal inside the circle), the gradient ring shrinks away and a red record badge pops onto the rim. Camera pushes in throughout.
pattern.why_premium: A decorative background element is promoted into the hero UI object, so the transition from brand world to product (Loom's circular camera bubble) has visual continuity instead of a cut; the record badge lands last as a clear product cue.

pattern.description: A hand cursor clicks the red stop button on the presenter bubble; the button collapses, the cursor exits, and a shared-video page assembles: the player card scales up from behind while the camera bubble shrinks into its lower-right corner, then the byline fades in and the title starts typing.
pattern.why_premium: One click causes the whole state change (record to shareable video) with no cut, demonstrating the product's core promise; the presenter bubble persists across states as the anchor, and the title typewriter keeps the eye moving after the main motion settles.

Camera bubble: same spring driving interpolate to corner x/y and scale 1→0.7. Byline: interpolate opacity over 9 frames starting ~frame 20. Manual boxes for the stop button and cursor are approximations since both leave the frame. The title is mid-typing at the end frame ('Wi'); the full title is likely in a later event.

pattern.description: A fast vertical whip: the cluster of multilingual greeting bubbles shoots up out of frame (energy peaks in the first ~6 frames), leaving an empty field; fresh spheres drift up from below and the two-line headline 'With Loom AI, / make your first take' fades up line by line, the second line held at reduced opacity.
pattern.why_premium: The whip reads as the whole world scrolling upward rather than a cut, keeping the floating-sphere universe continuous between scenes; the brief empty beat before the headline gives the line room to land, and the dimmed second line sets up a two-tone emphasis that later beats can complete.
